test_iqn_learner_full_pipeline: test the IQN learner by building a network, creating a learner, and running a single step
create_torso_network: create a torso network using sonnet Sequential with Flatten and MLP layers for intermediate representations
create_head_network: create a head network using sonnet MLP to output Q-values for a given number of actions
build_iqn_network: build an IQNNetwork with a torso, head, latent dimension, and quantile sample count for distributional RL
run_iqn_learner_step: run a single learning step of the IQN learner and verify step counts and state updates
